recipe.visualDefinition: A centered female portrait integrated into a complex layered environment of semi-transparent floral shapes, diagonal geometric color washes, and high-contrast fashion textures.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered behind a foreground of translucent purple geometric shards
Background composed of desaturated, painterly floral motifs in teal and white
High-contrast fashion textures (latex, pinstripes) grounded by soft organic overlays
Vertical text on the right balancing horizontal text on the left
coreInvariants: Monochromatic purple and lavender color cast across the entire frame
Sharp, high-definition subject focus against soft-focus background elements
Diagonal light/color beams cutting across the composition

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central medium shot, subject occupies approximately 60% of vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the dark, reflective texture of the latex bodice.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the face, moves down to the hands, then follows the diagonal purple beams outward to the text elements.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with layered textures and floral patterns.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Lavender and deep purple provide the overall atmospheric wash.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black and dark charcoal in the subject's clothing provide structural weight.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Teal and mint green in the background floral patterns; pops of red-orange in the sleeve cuffs.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the bright skin tones and dark clothing; low saturation in the background florals.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid bright primary yellows or blues

letterConstructionRules: Extreme vertical tracking for secondary text
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'b' features a diagonal slash or break in the stem
The 'a' is a single-story geometric circle with a short tail
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A bold, modified geometric lowercase wordmark paired with a delicate, vertically stacked uppercase secondary title.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the geometric circular base for the primary wordmark.
Ideal for the clean, vertical secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a fashion portrait of a woman in a pinstriped shirt and black latex vest, centered. Layer the background with desaturated teal and white floral patterns. Apply a heavy lavender and purple color wash. Add diagonal translucent purple shards and beams across the foreground and midground.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a bold geometric lowercase wordmark on the center-left. Place a light, vertically-stacked uppercase title along the right edge with wide spacing between letters.

verificationChecks: Is the purple color wash consistent across the image?
Does the primary text have a custom geometric modification?
Is the secondary text stacked vertically letter-by-letter?
Are the floral patterns desaturated compared to the purple overlays?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the purple color wash
Opacity of the diagonal geometric shards
Density of the background floral pattern
Specific color of the sleeve accents
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or logos
The exact slash mark in the wordmark 'b'
The specific facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Seamless blending of photography and vector overlays
Sophisticated color grading in the purple spectrum

postGenerationChecks: Check for visual balance between the left and right text elements.
Ensure the subject's face remains clear despite the overlays.
Verify the texture contrast between the latex and the soft florals.
Confirm the vertical text is perfectly aligned.
recipe.reuseFormula: Fashion Portrait + Floral Collage + Geometric Purple Overlays + Bi-Directional Sans-Serif Typography
